- Risk/impact: brief traffic drain and repopulation of KV caches; we expect a transient uptick in token latency for ~2 minutes during cutover. No model outputs or stored data will be modified.

Attachments: evidence_pack_v21c.zip (perf samples, canary traces), rollback_runbook.pdf (steps + rollback verification).
